subject: ggplot2 passing pixels instead of coordinates through input$plot_click on Shiny Server

messages.author: e0a7564bc8c6684a
messages.subject: ggplot2 passing pixels instead of coordinates through input$plot_click on Shiny Server
parts:
Hi All,

I'm running a Shiny app on a Shiny server. I am trying to make the ggplot clickable and return coordinates through plotOutput as detailed here: https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/plot-interaction.html

When I run the sample code:
library(shiny)
ui <- basicPage(
  plotOutput("plot1", click = "plot_click"),
  verbatimTextOutput("info")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg)
  })
  
  output$info <- renderText({
    paste0("x=", input$plot_click$x, "\ny=", input$plot_click$y)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

everything works correctly. However, when I replace plot with qplot, input$plot_click returns pixels instead of the x,y coordinates. This is also true for other ggplot2 functions.

Moreover, when I run the same program locally, with the same version of shiny and ggplot2 and the same packages attached, everything works correctly. 

The differences between sessionInfo() locally and on server:
R version: 3.3.2 (local) vs 3.3.0 (server)
OS: Sierra 10.12.3 (local) vs Ubuntu 14.04.5 LTS

Any ideas? Thanks very much!
